audit.why: Early/mid favors Draven (Q auto damage, passive gold snowball, E all-in setup), late favors Seraphine's CC in teamfights. Chart already agrees between full.side and content.win for all 7 rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit and its second bullet ('E Beat Drop is the lifeline') is a bled-in reference to Seraphine's OWN E, not a Draven cooldown, which makes the field describe the wrong champion's kit.
audit.why: The field exists specifically to hold real cooldown numbers per the audit brief; this one only has vague phrases and a misplaced self-reference.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Draven's real Q/E/R cooldowns and what each window means.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interaction: Draven's combo opens with Spinning Axe (Q), an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is the tell to disengage, not the cast itself. Not stated anywhere on the page.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags this as applicable and absent; lane engagement decisions hinge on reading the reset tell.
audit.corrected: Folded into breakdown.cooldowns: catching the axe resets Q, so a missed catch is the real damage window.

edits.before: - Draven Spinning Axe: matchup-defining — Two spinning axes is lane-bully damage — stand on his pickup spots and his power halves. Check it before every step-up. - E Beat Drop is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: Spinning Axe (Q) resets on a catch but starts at a 12s cooldown, falling to 8s at max — miss the catch and his damage halves for those seconds. Stand Aside (E) is 16-12s; it's down, step up. Whirling Death is 100-80s — bait it, not the wave.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: Cast W for the shield; the echoed W then heals — time it into his Spinning Axe autos to erase the poke.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Standing in front lets his Stand Aside knock you into his cooldown-favored trade and blocks your own support's peel.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'His Spinning Axe' as a possible wrong name (distance 4) — checked against enemyKit, Spinning Axe is Draven's real Q name, false positive, left alone. Packet defect claims the level chart 'contradicts' the 56.91% aggregate win rate, but full.phases[N].side and content.win[N] already agree with each other on every row (Draven 0-3, Skill 4-6), and an early/mid Draven lead flipping to a late Seraphine teamfight edge is consistent with the kits (Q auto damage + passive snowball early, W/E/R utility late) — an aggregate win rate isn't required to match every stage, so the chart was left as-is per the chart rule (do not move a row without a kit-grounded reason).
